invite: With the blessings of the Almighty and our elders, we joyfully invite you to share in the celebration of our wedding.

story.x: Two hands, one little promise, and a lifetime that began as a friendship.
Some feelings need no words. A flower, a glance, and the heart knows.
Every line of henna carries a blessing for the days ahead.
Two rings, two hearts, one vow, made in front of those we love.
Dhoti and red saree, hands held tight. We walk the road ahead as one.
Wherever the path leads, we will reach it side by side.
Soft lights, familiar faces, and a night we will remember forever.

events.x: The wedding ceremony. Muhurat as per the invitation card.
An evening of dinner, music and celebration.

closing: Your presence and blessings will make our day complete.
